capabilityIntro: Drafting production for contractors, facilities teams and design consultants. Start with one to three representative sheets so your reviewer can check the CAD format, plotted output and review process.
buyerRoles: Utility and civil contractor project managers
Design and bid teams coordinating drawing revisions

capabilities.title: Utility and mechanical record drawings
capabilities.summary: Use approved field markups to revise a utility or mechanical set and track details that need field confirmation.
inputs: Approved field markups with revision and sheet references
Editable base CAD and dependent references
Target sheet list, plot standards and handoff deadline
outputs: Revised native CAD and plotted sheet set in the agreed format
Exception log with sheet references and reviewer actions
checks: Compare incorporated changes with the approved markups
Validate affected layers, external references and plot readability
Keep unresolved dimensions and tie-ins visible for the buyer’s decision

capabilities.title: Legacy PDF and raster conversion
capabilities.summary: Rebuild legible archive drawings as editable linework organized by the buyer’s layer and block standards.
inputs: Readable scan or PDF and a known dimension reference
Required file version, layer naming and drawing conventions
Instructions for gaps, blurry symbols and conflicting dimensions
outputs: Visual overlay or plotted source comparison
checks: Calibrate against the supplied dimension and cross-check another known interval when available
Review line alignment, labels and units against the source

capabilities.title: Civil and survey drafting production
capabilities.summary: Prepare plans, profiles and crossing exhibits from approved survey records, stationing and design instructions.
inputs: Reviewer-approved source data and point or feature codes
Horizontal reference, vertical datum and units
Sheet template, callout list and drafting instructions
outputs: Assigned AutoCAD or Civil 3D files in the agreed format
Plotted sheets and dependent file manifest
Source point and missing-data notes for assigned review
checks: Confirm source identifiers, units and coordinate handling
Reconcile profile station and elevation labels with approved inputs
Log unknown attributes and wait for reviewer direction where needed

capabilities.title: Building existing-conditions drafting
capabilities.summary: Turn field sketches and recorded measurements into an editable architectural base for the design team.
inputs: Dimensioned sketch, authorized site measurements and any photos cleared for the drafting scope
Room and opening notes with any areas flagged for verification
CAD template, unit convention and required layout list
outputs: Dimensioned floor plan and assigned ceiling, observed-device or elevation sheets
Editable CAD and plotted sheets with matching layout IDs and revisions
Observation index and register for areas that need field verification
checks: Check tagged features and recorded opening widths against the source
Compare the CAD and plotted room dimensions and door symbols
Keep unverified conditions visible and route them to the client reviewer

capabilities.title: Addenda and drawing revisions
capabilities.summary: Carry supplied changes across affected sheets, then document the issue and the remaining inputs.
inputs: Batch priorities, reviewers and revision cadence
outputs: Each dated production batch with revision status
Manifest for files, references and unresolved inputs
Batch closeout notes for the designated reviewer
checks: Compare each revised sheet with its approved instruction
Confirm working files and plotted sheets match the issue register
Capture approved revision requests and return open decisions to the owner

formats: DWG or Civil 3D version agreed for production work
Plotted PDFs with matching sheet IDs and revisions
Drawing index, change log and agreed reference files
AutoCAD 2018 DWG with named layouts and matching review PDFs in the technical samples
requirements: Authorized source set with revision and sheet references
Target CAD version, units, drawing template and plot conventions
Reference files, designated reviewer and secure transfer method
boundaries: The buyer’s accountable reviewer handles field verification, survey determinations and interpretation of design intent.
Engineering approval, professional sealing and permitting remain with the designated accountable professionals.
An unclear source detail stays logged until the buyer directs its disposition.

projects.title: Alder Drive utility closeout
projects.summary: A 640 ft water-main corridor with two plan/profile sheets, an observed utility crossing, an asset schedule and one connection held for field verification.
projects.imageAlt: U-101 water record plan and profile showing the accepted route, moved valve and measured crossing

comparison.label: FR-01 · Field redline
comparison.alt: Simulated contractor markup with three red instructions for the route, valve and crossing
comparison.caption: The contractor’s simulated instructions cite source shots for the offset, valve and measured crossing.

comparison.label: U-101 · Record plan and profile
comparison.alt: Record sheet with accepted plan geometry and water crown profile
comparison.caption: The issued plan and profile carry those changes into the same stationing.

projects.context: The fictional closeout lead inherited a water-main plan and a contractor field batch. The record set carries the accepted geometry, elevations and asset tags into a two-sheet corridor. The last accepted crown is at 6+18. The connection near 6+40 stays open.
constraints: Use the supplied station, offset and crown values in a fictional local coordinate and elevation system.
Record the measured utility gap at 2+16 and route any compliance or release decision to the project reviewer.
Stop the accepted water-crown line at 6+18. Draw the possible tie-in as a dashed diagram and carry E-01 into the schedule.

approach.title: Locate the changes
approach.text: Trace each field instruction to FR-01 or FR-02. The route moves up to 9 ft between 1+20 and 2+68, and V-03 moves from 1+60 to 1+83.

approach.title: Update affected drawings together
approach.text: Revise the plan and plotted crown, record the measured 1.56 ft gap on the crossing detail, and update the schedule with the same asset IDs and stations.

approach.title: Hand back the hold
approach.text: Prepare the E-01 exception with the last accepted shot and three affected sheets so the reviewer can request the exact field observation.

deliverables: Five DWG layouts and five 17 × 11 in vector PDF sheets
Contractor source markup, recorded station/offset/crown values and crossing measurements
Asset inventory and change register with sheet references
verification: Check route change extents, the V-03 station and the 3+20 matchline against the field observation table.
Recalculate 102.38 ft minus 100.82 ft and match the 1.56 ft observation on U-101 and U-501.
Check that U-102, U-501 and U-601 all carry the final connection hold, with no accepted crown published beyond 6+18.
Reopen the working DWG through the ODA converter and compare the geometry, layers and named layouts with the source CAD.
projects.review: The closeout lead owns the field follow-up and acceptance of the final record.

projects.title: Juniper Office existing conditions
projects.summary: A 2,304 sq ft office with a measured floor plan, ceiling plan, observed power and data, and an interior elevation keyed to the field view index.
projects.imageAlt: A-101 measured floor plan showing nine room tags, ten doors and dimension chains

comparison.label: MS-01 · Measured shell sketch
comparison.alt: Dimensioned simulated source sketch with four observation view callouts
comparison.caption: The source uses a consistent origin and four view IDs to direct drafting and field follow-up.

comparison.label: A-101 · Measured floor plan
comparison.alt: Dimensioned floor plan for nine spaces with door tags and a break room reference
comparison.caption: The floor plan carries partition dimensions, door widths and the break room elevation reference.

projects.context: A fictional design team asked for an editable base of an existing office. The simulated measurement sketch and observation tables cover nine spaces, ten visible openings and eighteen power, data and panel locations.
constraints: Use the southwest shell corner as the origin and maintain the same room geometry across the floor, ceiling and device plans.
Use recorded visible opening dimensions. The D01 rough opening needs verification if the design team relies on it.
Leave the storage ceiling construction and height, and circuit assignments, open for follow-up.

approach.title: Reconcile the sketch
approach.text: Close the 64 ft and 36 ft dimension chains against the nominal shell. Add consistent door and room tags from the source tables.

approach.title: Separate the observed systems
approach.text: Use the same geometry for the reflected ceiling and device plans. Carry only reported ceiling finishes, fixture groups and visible device locations.

approach.title: Index the interior evidence
approach.text: Tie the recorded break room counter and cabinet measurements to view V02 and list the remaining site questions by view and sheet.

deliverables: Five DWG layouts and five 17 × 11 in vector PDF sheets
Measured sketch, interior observations, and source tables for rooms, openings and devices
View-to-drawing index and field verification register
verification: Check the nominal area and dimension chains. Reconcile door and room tags with the source tables.
Compare the A-121 ceiling tags, E-101 device IDs and A-401 elevation dimensions against MS-02 and the observation index.
Verify the three field follow-ups remain visible in the relevant issued sheets and review register.
Reopen the DWG and verify that named layout viewports keep the same room geometry while isolating discipline layers.
projects.review: The design team and field reviewer own any verification required before relying on these conditions. The sample uses simulated view observations.

projects.title: Cedar Service Court civil redlines
projects.summary: A site and utility revision from a supplied survey attachment. The pad, curb and utility changes stay coordinated across the plan, profile and comment responses.
projects.imageAlt: C-101 site plan with revised equipment pad, curb limit and utility approach above the survey base

comparison.label: SK-01 · Engineer markup
comparison.alt: Four review tags on a simulated engineer markup over survey linework
comparison.caption: The source identifies the revised pad bounds, curb limits, released profile points and a downstream hold.

comparison.label: C-101 · Revised site plan
comparison.alt: Plan with coordinated site and utility revisions over the unchanged survey drawing reference
comparison.caption: The plan carries those changes against the supplied survey base and flags the connection for reviewer input.

projects.context: A fictional civil engineer issues four redlines against supplied site geometry. The production handoff includes the revised plans, a response for each engineer comment and an attached survey-base DWG.
constraints: Keep the survey linework and local coordinate system in the supplied reference. Edit the new production geometry in the host drawing.
Use the recorded 32 × 20 ft equipment-pad bounds, the 30 ft curb-restoration limit, and the six issued utility crown elevations.
Mark the existing utility connection as open beyond 1+50 and send it back to the civil lead for direction.

approach.title: Attach the supplied base
approach.text: Retain the survey as a separate DWG using a relative path. Use the supplied grid and contour-check records to orient the drawings.

approach.title: Draft across affected sheets
approach.text: Draft the pad and curb changes on C-101. Transfer the curb limits and issued X-02 elevations to C-201. Keep the exception visible in both.

approach.title: Close the comments with evidence
approach.text: Show the two independent plan dimensions, cross-check the station limits and link the unresolved comment to its engineer decision.

deliverables: Four host DWG layouts and four 17 × 11 in vector PDF sheets
Separate survey-base DWG, survey points, engineer markups and profile observations
Comment and dimension checks with a downstream connection hold
verification: Confirm the plan shows the 32 ft east-west and 20 ft north-south pad extents from the instructed coordinates.
Check the C-101 curb limits against the C-201 profile graphic and reconcile the six labeled crowns with SK-02.
Verify the host file retains a relative survey-base DWG reference and the ZIP contains that file beside the host.
Check that CR-04 appears on the plan, profile and response sheet. Obtain engineered connection direction before any further release.
projects.review: The responsible engineer reviews the set and supplies the missing connection decision. The sample demonstrates 2D CAD production from supplied records.
